selection.edition: international Happy Scribe Product API v1
selection.ownership: Happy Scribe Spain S.L. (CIF B02911691), Carrer de Santa Teresa 6, 08012 Barcelona, Spain. International transcription product at happyscribe.com, not a mainland-China edition.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Happy Scribe Product API (host https://www.happyscribe.com/api/v1, Bearer token, GET /organizations, /transcriptions, /transcriptions/{id}, /orders/{id}, 401 for a wrong key), Happy Scribe Spain S.L. Barcelona identity, SOC 2 Type II / GDPR claims, and dated incident search. Scribe Media 2023 corporate turmoil is a distinct US publisher. No qualifying current unresolved Happy Scribe compromise was identified in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Happy Scribe Product API v1
research.searchCoverage: Official Happy Scribe API documents HTTPS host https://www.happyscribe.com/api/v1, Authorization: Bearer, GET /organizations, GET /transcriptions with required organization_id, GET /transcriptions/{id}, GET /orders/{id}, and 401 for a wrong key. Operator is Happy Scribe Spain S.L. in Barcelona. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying current unresolved Happy Scribe compromise.

incidents.finding: Bounded search of Happy Scribe / HappyScribe / Happy Scribe Spain security breach and incident coverage on 2026-09-13 identified no current unresolved customer-data compromise.
incidents.limitation: This is not a breach-free claim; live authentication remains unverified.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: POST /exports with nested export {format, transcription_ids, show_*}. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_EXPORT_TRANSCRIPTION.
CamelCase input (transcriptionIds, showTimestamps, timestampsFrequency) maps to official snake_case body fields.
Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data instead of {export: payload}.
GET /exports/{exportId}. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_RETRIEVE_EXPORT. Composio uses id.
Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /organizations, matching the pinned validator. Create/confirm order, update/delete transcription, and export writes are omitted.
Native category is productivity: Happy Scribe is a transcription/subtitling workspace. Source AI/Productivity are not both in the Rust CATEGORIES allowlist.
Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data instead of the upstream {organizations, raw} unwrap. The upstream user-agent is not sent.
POST /orders/{orderId}/confirm with no body. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_CONFIRM_ORDER.
Empty 200/204 maps to {confirmed: true, orderId} instead of wrapping a missing JSON body.
POST /orders with nested order. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_CREATE_SUBTITLE (set isSubtitle true for subtitles).
Current Product API replaces deprecated POST /transcriptions. organizationId is an integer as documented for orders.
Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data instead of {order: payload}.
POST /orders/translation with nested order.target_languages array. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_CREATE_TRANSLATION_ORDER.
Composio wraps parameters in an order object; AppCall flattens them. Returns raw JSON under data.
orderId is a required path segment on GET /orders/{id}. Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data instead of {order: payload}.
Maps to Composio HAPPY_SCRIBE_RETRIEVE_ORDER. Origin orderId is kept (Composio uses id).
Returns raw GET /organizations JSON under data.
DELETE /transcriptions/{transcriptionId} with optional permanent query. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_DELETE_TRANSCRIPTION.
204/empty 200 maps to {deleted: true, transcriptionId}. Composio uses id.
transcriptionId is a required path segment on GET /transcriptions/{id}. Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data instead of {transcription: payload}.
Maps to Composio HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_TRANSCRIPTION. Origin transcriptionId is kept (Composio uses id).
organizationId is required and sent as organization_id. Optional page, per_page, and folder_id use official query names. Native perPage is bounded to 1-100.
Optional tags are sent as repeated tags query parameters (Composio HAPPY_SCRIBE_LIST_TRANSCRIPTIONS). Pinned source comma-joined the array; repeated params avoid a handwritten handler.
Returns raw GET /transcriptions JSON under data.
Official but deprecated POST /task/transcription_translation. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_CREATE_TRANSLATION_TASK.
Pinned open-connector does not wrap this route; the body matches official docs (source_transcription_id, target_language).
Official but deprecated GET /task/transcription_translation/{translationTaskId}. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_RETRIEVE_TRANSLATION_TASK.
Pinned open-connector does not wrap this route.
GET /uploads/new?filename=. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_SIGNED_UPLOAD_URL.
Pinned open-connector does not wrap this route. The PUT to the returned S3 URL is out of network allowlist on purpose.
Authenticates with GET /organizations and infers Product API v1 from the public base path. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_API_VERSION.
Happy Scribe does not publish a /version endpoint. Optional organizationId and endpointPreference are not sent upstream.
Authenticates with GET /organizations, then returns the official General-page error table. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_ERROR_CODES.
Happy Scribe has no /errors endpoint.
Authenticates with GET /organizations, then returns the official Create-an-Export format chart. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_SUPPORTED_FORMATS.
Happy Scribe has no /formats endpoint. Composio includeAudio/includeVideo/exportCategory/limit/testNote are not sent upstream.
Authenticates with documented GET /organizations, then returns the official BCP-47 language catalog. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_LANGUAGE_LIST.
Happy Scribe has no /languages endpoint. Composio filterHumanService is not sent upstream; filter client-side using humanService.
Official GET /organization_memberships with optional organization_id, role, email, name, page. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_ACCOUNT_DETAILS.
Pinned open-connector does not wrap this route. Regular members see only their own row.
Returns raw Happy Scribe JSON under data.
Authenticates with GET /organizations, then returns the documented 200 transcription-creation requests per hour limit. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_RATE_LIMIT.
Happy Scribe does not expose rate-limit headers or a /rate_limit endpoint.

exports.create.description: Create an asynchronous Happy Scribe export for one or more transcriptions (txt, srt, vtt, json, and other documented formats). Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_EXPORT_TRANSCRIPTION.

format.description: Export format such as txt, docx, pdf, srt, vtt, json, csv, or docx.

transcriptionIds.description: Transcription identifiers included in the export.

timestampsFrequency.description: Inline timestamp interval when showTimestamps is true.

exports.create.title: Create export

exports.get.description: Get a Happy Scribe export, including the download link when state is ready. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_RETRIEVE_EXPORT.

exportId.description: Export identifier returned by create export.

exports.get.title: Get export

healthcheck.description: Validate the Happy Scribe API key with GET /organizations.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

orders.confirm.description: Confirm a previously created Happy Scribe order that is still incomplete. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_CONFIRM_ORDER.
orders.confirm.title: Confirm order

orders.create.description: Create a Happy Scribe transcription or subtitling order from a public media URL. Set isSubtitle true for subtitles. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_CREATE_SUBTITLE.

url.description: Public media URL Happy Scribe can fetch during ingestion.

language.description: BCP-47 language code such as en-US.

service.description: auto for machine or pro for human transcription/subtitles.

confirm.description: Submit immediately. When false the order stays incomplete until confirmed.

name.description: Display name of the resulting transcription.

folder.description: Destination folder path such as path/to/folder.

isSubtitle.description: When true, produce subtitles instead of a plain transcript.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL notified when the order changes state.

tags.description: Tags attached to the resulting transcription.

glossaryIds.description: Glossary identifiers applied to the order.

styleGuideId.description: Style guide identifier applied to the order.

orders.create.title: Create transcription or subtitle order

orders.createTranslation.description: Create a Happy Scribe translation order from an existing transcription into one or more languages. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_CREATE_TRANSLATION_ORDER.

sourceTranscriptionId.description: Source transcription identifier. Must be complete.

targetLanguages.description: Target language codes such as es or pt-BR.

service.description: auto for machine or pro for human translation.

confirm.description: Submit immediately. When false the order stays incomplete until confirmed.

webhookUrl.description: HTTPS URL notified when the order changes state.

orders.createTranslation.title: Create translation order

orders.get.description: Get the current state of a Happy Scribe order by ID. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_RETRIEVE_ORDER.
orders.get.title: Get order

organizations.list.description: List Happy Scribe organizations available to the API key.
organizations.list.title: List organizations

transcriptions.delete.description: Delete a Happy Scribe transcription. Unfinished jobs are cancelled when the pipeline allows it. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_DELETE_TRANSCRIPTION.

permanent.description: When true, delete irreversibly instead of moving to Trash.

transcriptions.delete.title: Delete transcription

transcriptions.get.description: Get one Happy Scribe transcription by ID. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_TRANSCRIPTION.
transcriptions.get.title: Get transcription

transcriptions.list.description: List Happy Scribe transcriptions in an organization. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_LIST_TRANSCRIPTIONS.

tags.description: Filter to transcriptions that match every listed tag.

transcriptions.list.title: List transcriptions

translationTasks.create.description: Deprecated Product API: create an AI translation task for a completed transcription. Prefer orders.createTranslation. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_CREATE_TRANSLATION_TASK.

sourceTranscriptionId.description: Source transcription identifier. Must be in automatic_done state.

targetLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 target language code such as es or de.

translationTasks.create.title: Create translation task

translationTasks.get.description: Deprecated Product API: get a translation task, including translatedTranscriptionId when done. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_RETRIEVE_TRANSLATION_TASK.

translationTaskId.description: Translation task identifier returned by create translation task.

translationTasks.get.title: Get translation task

uploads.new.description: Get a signed S3 URL for uploading media into Happy Scribe storage. Use the same URL as tmp_url/url when creating a transcription or order. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_SIGNED_UPLOAD_URL.

filename.description: Upload filename including extension, such as interview.mp4.

uploads.new.title: Get signed upload URL

api.version.description: Infer the Happy Scribe Product API version from GET /organizations. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_API_VERSION. Happy Scribe does not publish a /version endpoint; the public base path is /api/v1.
api.version.title: Get API version

organizationId.description: Optional organization id accepted for Composio compatibility. The version probe does not send it.

endpointPreference.description: Composio probe preference. This connector always uses GET /organizations.

errorCodes.list.description: Return the documented Happy Scribe HTTP error codes after authenticating with GET /organizations. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_ERROR_CODES. There is no /errors endpoint.
errorCodes.list.title: Get error codes

errorCodes.meaning: Bad Request -- Your request is invalid.
Unauthorized -- Your API key is wrong or you don't have permission to access that resource.
Forbidden -- The resource requested is hidden for administrators only.
Not Found -- The specified resource could not be found.
Method Not Allowed -- You tried to access a resource with an invalid method.
Not Acceptable -- You requested a format that isn't json.
Conflict -- The resource is in a state that does not allow the requested action.
Gone -- The resource requested has been removed from our servers.
Unprocessable Entity -- There was an error processing your request.
Too Many Requests -- You're requesting too many resources! Slow down!
Internal Server Error -- We had a problem with our server. Try again later.
Service Unavailable -- We're temporarily offline for maintenance. Please try again later.

formats.list.description: Return documented Happy Scribe export formats after authenticating with GET /organizations. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_HS_GET_SUPPORTED_FORMATS. There is no /formats endpoint.
formats.list.title: Get supported formats

limit.description: Composio limit on formats returned. This connector returns the full official export chart.

testNote.description: Optional Composio test note. Not sent upstream.

includeAudio.description: Composio audio-input flag. Official docs list mp3 as an export of source audio.

includeVideo.description: Composio video-input flag. Official docs list mp4 as an export of source video.

exportCategory.description: Composio category filter. This connector returns the full official export chart.

languages.list.description: Return documented Happy Scribe BCP-47 language codes after authenticating with GET /organizations. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_LANGUAGE_LIST. There is no /languages endpoint.
languages.list.title: Get supported languages

filterHumanService.description: Composio human-service filter. This connector returns the full documented catalog; filter client-side using humanService.

memberships.list.description: List Happy Scribe organization memberships for the API key, including email, name, and role. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_ACCOUNT_DETAILS. Regular members see only their own row.
memberships.list.title: Get account details

organizationId.description: Restrict memberships to one organization. Omit to list memberships across organizations the caller belongs to.

email.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the member email.

name.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the member full name.

page.description: Page number to fetch. Official default is 1, 25 rows per page.

rateLimits.get.description: Return the documented Happy Scribe transcription-creation rate limit after authenticating with GET /organizations. Maps to HAPPY_SCRIBE_GET_RATE_LIMIT. Happy Scribe does not expose rate-limit headers.
rateLimits.get.title: Get API rate limit
